{%- capture rhino_consumer_route -%}{%- render 'rhino-product-consumer-route', product: product -%}{%- endcapture -%}
{%- assign rhino_legacy_content = false -%}
{%- if rhino_consumer_route == 'replacement_part' or rhino_consumer_route == 'consumable' or rhino_consumer_route == 'accessory' -%}{%- assign rhino_legacy_content = true -%}{%- endif -%}
{%- liquid
  assign og_title = page_title | default: shop.name
  assign og_url = canonical_url | default: request.origin
  assign og_url = og_url | split: '?' | first
  assign og_type = 'website'
  assign og_description = page_description | default: shop.description | default: shop.name
  assign default_social_image_alt = 'Rhino Lapidary brand image with logo on a dark background'
  assign default_social_image_url = 'rhino-og-default.jpg' | asset_url
  assign social_image = nil
  assign social_image_alt = ''
  assign social_image_height = ''
  assign social_image_url = ''
  assign social_image_width = ''

  if request.page_type == 'product'
    assign og_type = 'product'
    if rhino_legacy_content == false
      assign og_title = product.title
      assign og_description = ''
    endif
    assign product_social_image = product.featured_media.preview_image | default: product.featured_image
    if product_social_image and rhino_legacy_content
      assign social_image = product_social_image
      assign product_social_image_alt = product.featured_media.alt | default: product_social_image.alt
      if product_social_image_alt != blank
        assign social_image_alt = product_social_image_alt
      endif
    endif
  elsif request.page_type == 'article'
    assign og_type = 'article'
    if article.image
      assign social_image = article.image
    endif
  elsif request.page_type == 'collection'
    if collection.image
      assign social_image = collection.image
    endif
  elsif request.page_type == 'password'
    assign og_url = request.origin
  endif

  if social_image
    assign social_image_width = social_image.width | default: 1200
    assign social_image_height = social_image.height | default: 630
    assign social_image_url = social_image | image_url: width: social_image_width

    if social_image_alt == blank and social_image.alt != blank
      assign social_image_alt = social_image.alt
    endif
  endif

  if social_image_alt == blank
    if request.page_type == 'product' and product.title != blank
      assign social_image_alt = product.title
    elsif request.page_type == 'collection' and collection.title != blank
      assign social_image_alt = collection.title
    elsif request.page_type == 'article' and article.title != blank
      assign social_image_alt = article.title
    else
      assign social_image_alt = default_social_image_alt
    endif
  endif

  if social_image_url == blank
    assign social_image_url = default_social_image_url
    assign social_image_width = 1200
    assign social_image_height = 630
    assign social_image_alt = default_social_image_alt
  endif

  assign social_image_url_prefix = social_image_url | slice: 0, 2

  if social_image_url contains 'http://'
    assign social_image_url = social_image_url | replace_first: 'http://', 'https://'
  elsif social_image_url_prefix == '//'
    assign social_image_url = social_image_url | prepend: 'https:'
  elsif social_image_url != blank
    assign social_image_url = social_image_url | prepend: request.origin
  endif
%}

# Decisions extracted from the completed Rhino team worksheet

This is a transcription/normalization aid for the next repository agent. Do not treat ambiguous handwriting as stronger than the source PDF.

## Compatibility
- Automatic Feed Clamp: one physical clamp fits both SawMaster 18 and SawMaster 24; historical numbering differs for another reason. Both fit edges were marked approved.
- Saw Vice Plate Set: two physically different sets, one per machine. Team marked that Rhino should sell them separately. The current single Shopify Product identity remains unresolved until a catalog split strategy is chosen.
- All 38 non-blocked compatibility relationships in the prior worksheet were marked Approve.

## Technical facts answered
- BeadMaster 6: 110 V / 60 Hz; motor speed 3000 rpm.
- ShapeMaster 6: 110 V / 60 Hz; motor speed 3000 rpm.
- TrimMaster 8: 110 V / 60 Hz; motor speed 3000 rpm.
- LapMaster 12: 110 V / 60 Hz.
- LapMaster 18: 110 V / 60 Hz; motor power 1 hp.
- SawMaster 18: 110 V / 60 Hz; 1.8 kW; 1700 rpm; 450 mm and 18 in marked as the same nominal blade size.
- SawMaster 24: 110 V / 60 Hz; 1.8 kW; 1700 rpm; 600 mm and 24 in marked as the same nominal blade size.
- Horsepower convention: manufacturer nameplate horsepower.
- EM-1: 110 V; 1 hp; primary motor speed handwritten as <=5000 rpm (not an exact scalar); wheel operating range 0-3000 rpm; flexible-shaft range handwritten 500-5000 rpm; wheel diameter 6 in; wheel arbor 1 in; reservoir 3.5 gal; water system described as reservoir filtration with adjustable water outlets. Frequency and gallon convention were not definitively answered.

## Measurement corrections answered
- SawMaster 36 assembled first dimension corrected from 72 ft to 72 in.
- LapMaster 18 net weight handwritten as 105 lb.
- LapMaster 18 packed/shipping observation handwritten as 200 lb. Native Shopify shipping weight remains a separate domain.

## EM-1 box contents
- 80 grit selected instead of 60 grit.
- 280 grit marked included.
- Every listed contents row in the original checklist was marked Yes/included.
- Moss filtration pads explicitly annotated quantity 2.
- Exact quantities for most other lines were not explicitly written; do not infer them merely from inclusion.

## File/resource decisions already answered
- Canonical duplicate: LapMaster 12.pdf.
- Canonical duplicate: LapMaster 18.pdf.
- Canonical duplicate: BeadMaster.pdf.
- Canonical duplicate: TrimMaster.pdf.
- Videos 003 and 004 marked same content.
- Videos 017 and 018 marked same content.
- No first-priority resource publication-rights/language/current-version decisions were completed.

## Abrasive grit
- Grading standard written as CAMI.
- Store manufacturer's printed grit number exactly.
- For mixed-grit products/packs, store every included grit value.
